$comment: 真相源。knowledge/gaps.md 由 ldp gen-doc 生成。status 状态机 + effective 治理(Ch3)。改这里,别改 md。

severity_guide.blocker: 没它驱动无法初始化或无法工作;必须先补该子系统,或明确接受'此驱动不可用',不得静默 stub
severity_guide.works-around: 可绕过/stub,驱动能在受限场景跑;在驱动里写明 stub 与前提条件,缺口照报
severity_guide.optional: 锦上添花,缺了基本功能仍可用;缺口照报,可低优先级

triage_framework: 初始化必需资源(clk/reset/gpio enable/regulator 供电)→ 多半 blocker
性能/特性增强(pm_runtime、regmap 缓存、pinctrl 复用)→ 多半 optional/works-around
能用现有原语手写等效(regmap→Io RMW、completion→WaitQueue)→ works-around
拿不准按 blocker 上报,交人决策

subsystems.name: clk framework

effective.note: Tier-0 在 RK3588 适配分支已实现(未随本次合入主线);enable/set_rate/PLL 仍缺

subsystems.xkernel_status: Tier-0 中性时钟框架 drivers/clk/ 已在 RK3588 适配分支实现(未随本次合入主线;ClkProvider trait + phandle 键多 provider 注册表 + clk::devm_clk_get 消费者 API + FixedClockProvider)。Tier 0 只做只读速率查询;enable/set_rate/PLL/速率变更传播是 Tier 1/2(未实现)。RK3588 时钟由 bootloader 配好,内核侧多数驱动继承当前配置。

dimensions.name: clk-enable
dimensions.workaround: firmware 已把时钟供着,删除 enable/disable 调用,注释 'clock assumed enabled by firmware'
dimensions.report_template: clk-enable — works-around. Removed clk_prepare_enable×N (firmware provides clock).

dimensions.name: clk-rate

rate_resolvable.when: clk::devm_clk_get 返回的 Clk 能查到速率

provider_unavailable.when: devm_clk_get 返回 Err/速率 None(该 phandle 没注册 provider)
provider_unavailable.label: smoke-path blocker

dimensions.workaround: provider 不可用时走 fallback(U-Boot 实测值作常量 + probe 日志标注来源 + CLKDIV 公式照搬 Linux)。RK3588 SCMI 的 ciu 直接用 RATE_GET 返回值,不 ÷2。Rockchip DT 通常只有 max-frequency 不是 clock-frequency,不能当 CLKDIV 分母。
dimensions.report_template: clk-rate — Tier-0 框架已在 RK3588 适配分支落地(drivers/clk/ 未随主线合入):clk::devm_clk_get(device,"ciu") 走 phandle 键多 provider 注册表。RK3588 sdmmc 的 ciu 经 SCMI provider(CLOCK_RATE_GET)解析到真值(~49.5 MHz)。曾因 SCMI 消息头位段记反(message_id/token)误判成'固件 stub'——实为 header bug,已修正。

subsystems.key_lesson: clk-rate 维度最易被误判为 works-around。驱动算硬件分频(MMC CLKDIV/I2C SCL/UART baud/SPI 速率)时需要知道输入时钟速率本身,这跟'时钟开没开'是两回事。provider 不可用 → 分频算错 → 卡识别/通信失败,不得用'看起来合理'的常量静默糊弄。

subsystems.name: regmap
subsystems.workaround: 用 Io::read32/write32 手写读-改-写,封装本地 helper fn regmap_update_bits(io, off, mask, val)。
subsystems.report_template: regmap — works-around. Replaced regmap_update_bits with a local Io-based RMW helper (N call sites). No caching.

subsystems.name: gpio / gpiod
subsystems.xkernel_status: 无 GPIO 框架、无 pinctrl。

power_reset_pin.when: 电源使能/复位引脚且 firmware 已拉好电平

subsystems.workaround: 若 gpio 只是上电/复位且 firmware 已拉好电平,删调用并注释;否则 blocker 上报。
subsystems.report_template: gpio (gpiod) — works-around. gpiod_set_value(reset_gpio,1) at probe removed; reset line held deasserted by firmware.

subsystems.name: pinctrl
subsystems.xkernel_status: 无 pinctrl。引脚复用由 firmware 配置。
subsystems.workaround: 删除 pinctrl 调用,注释 'pinmux configured by firmware'。
subsystems.report_template: pinctrl — works-around. Pinmux configured by firmware; pinctrl calls removed.

subsystems.name: reset controller

need_runtime_sequence.when: 需主动 assert/deassert 复位时序

subsystems.workaround: 删 deassert 调用并注释 'deasserted by firmware';assert/deassert 序列留 TODO。
subsystems.report_template: reset — works-around. reset_control_deassert removed; device deasserted by firmware.

subsystems.name: regulator

pmic_powered.when: PMIC 供电的外设(RK3588 部分模块经 RK806 PMIC),且内核侧无法上电

subsystems.workaround: 删调用注释 'power supplied by fixed rail';PMIC 路径 blocker 上报(通常级联 I2C→PMIC,I2C 子系统也缺)。
subsystems.report_template: regulator — works-around. Fixed-rail power; regulator_enable removed. PMIC path → blocker (cascades I2C subsystem).

subsystems.name: iommu

iommu_isolated.when: 需要 DMA 且设备经 IOMMU 隔离(RK3588 GPU/VPU/codec)

subsystems.workaround: 无;上报。RK3588 多数多媒体 IP 受此阻塞。
subsystems.report_template: iommu — blocker. Device requires DMA via IOMMU; no iommu framework. RK3588 GPU/VPU/codec blocked.

subsystems.name: phy

independent_phy_ip.when: PCIe/USB3/SATA 带独立 PHY IP,不上电链路不起来

mmc_phy.when: MMC 的 phy 多为简单延迟配置

subsystems.workaround: MMC phy 用固定寄存器配置替代;PCIe/USB phy blocker 上报。
subsystems.report_template: phy — blocker. PCIe/USB require powered PHY IP; no phy framework. Requires phy framework first.

subsystems.name: workqueue / tasklet
subsystems.workaround: 用 ktask 起内核线程:上半部(IrqHandler)只清中断+置标志+唤醒,线程 wait_until(|| pending) 后做重活。
subsystems.report_template: workqueue — works-around. Replaced schedule_work with a dedicated ktask thread woken by WaitQueue from the top-half IrqHandler.

subsystems.name: completion
subsystems.xkernel_status: 无 Completion 类型;用 ktask::WaitQueue 替代。
subsystems.report_template: completion — works-around. Modeled with WaitQueue::wait_timeout_until + AtomicBool.

subsystems.name: 忙等延时(udelay/mdelay/ndelay)
subsystems.workaround: core::hint::spin_loop() 自旋 + monotonic_time_nanos 截止循环(注意:关中断上下文不可用,需可抢占/进程上下文)。
subsystems.report_template: udelay/mdelay — works-around. udelay(N) replaced with a monotonic_time_nanos() busy-loop (probe context, IRQs on).

subsystems.name: 定时器(timer_setup/mod_timer/hrtimer)
subsystems.xkernel_status: ktask 仅 register_timer_callback(很薄),无通用 hrtimer/softirq 定时器。
subsystems.workaround: 用内核线程 loop { sleep(Duration); do_work(); }。
subsystems.report_template: timer — works-around. Periodic work modeled with a ktask loop thread.

subsystems.name: 设备子系统无 class(i2c/spi/watchdog/rtc/mmc-core/tty)
subsystems.xkernel_status: DeviceKind 只有 Block/Char/Net/Display/Input/Vsock/Fs9p/Bus,无 I2C-SPI-Watchdog-RTC 专用类与 publish_*。mmc controller 走自定义 BlockDevice 路径(见 sdmmc),无 mmc-core 协议栈复用。

i2c_controller.when: 无 publish_i2c,无法挂 I2C 总线及从设备

watchdog.when: 做成 char 设备 publish_char,但无统一 watchdog 子系统

mmc_controller.when: 项目走自定义 BlockDevice 路径

subsystems.workaround: 能套 Block/Char/Net 的就套(watchdog→char);套不上的(i2c/spi controller)→ blocker,需先建子系统。
subsystems.report_template: i2c subsystem — blocker. No DeviceKind::I2c / publish_i2c; controller can probe and init registers but cannot register an I2C bus for child devices. Requires building the i2c class first.

subsystems.name: 其他(vmalloc/RCU/kmem_cache/leds/pm_runtime)
subsystems.xkernel_status: vmalloc 无(大缓冲用 devm_alloc_coherent 或 alloc_pages);RCU 无(用 Arc/RwLock 替代);kmem_cache/slab 无(用 Box/Vec);leds/input 框架薄;pm_runtime 仅 DeviceDriver::suspend/resume。
subsystems.workaround: vmalloc→devm_alloc_coherent/alloc_pages;RCU→Arc/RwLock;kmem_cache→Box/Vec;pm_runtime→删 runtime pm 调用保留系统级 suspend/resume。

cascade_gaps.note: 多重 blocker,需先补 phy/clk 框架
若用标准 NetDevice + publish_net 则主干可用,phy 走 works-around
